items.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 22 at 8:59PM PDT until October 24 at 9:00AM PDT by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures of 33 to 36 degrees will result in frost
formation.

* WHERE...Portions of northwest and west central Oregon and southwest
Washington.

* WHEN...From 11 PM Friday to 9 AM PDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.
items.instruction:
Take steps now to protect tender outdoor plants from the cold.
Consider temporarily moving outdoor potted plants indoors if they are
sensitive to cold temperatures, or temporarily covering sensitive
plants with a lightweight cotton fabric (i.e., bedsheets, thin
blankets), as this will help retain heat and provide frost protection
for your plants.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 22 at 8:07PM PDT until October 23 at 5:00PM PDT by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Hazardous Seas Warning, very steep and
hazardous seas 9 to 11 ft at 10 seconds and north winds 15 to
25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt. For the Small Craft Advisory,
seas 7 to 11 ft at 11 seconds and north winds 10 to 20 kt with
gusts up to 25 kt expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Waters from Cape Shoalwater to Florence out 60
NM.

* WHEN...Hazardous Seas Warning, until 8 AM PDT Friday. Small
Craft Advisory, from 8 AM to 5 PM PDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Very steep and hazardous seas could capsize or cause
damage to vessels.
items.instruction:
A Hazardous Seas Warning means hazardous sea conditions are
imminent or occurring. Recreational boaters should remain in
port, or take shelter until waves subside.  Commercial vessels
should prepare for rough seas and consider remaining in port or
taking shelter in port until hazardous seas subside.
